releases.body:
## 4.37.9

### Bug Fixes

* **graphql:** enforce introspection policy on websocket operations ([#2129](https://github.com/unraid/api/issues/2129))

## 4.37.8

### Bug Fixes

* **api:** preserve partial results ([#2123](https://github.com/unraid/api/issues/2123))
* **graphql:** filter schema metadata requests ([#2095](https://github.com/unraid/api/issues/2095))
* **web:** restore banner fade (#2126)
* Sandbox now disabled for all users

2095.title: fix(graphql): filter schema metadata requests
2095.body: Disables introspection (__schema/__type) unless the sandbox is enabled.

2123.title: fix(api): preserve partial results and accurate notification counts
2123.body: Makes the docker and vms roots nullable so one failed service no longer nulls the response.

2126.title: fix(web): restore right-side banner fade on legacy headers

2129.title: fix(graphql): enforce introspection policy on websocket operations
2129.body: Applies the introspection policy to subscriptions.
